jsQR 1.4.0 (https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR), Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE), unmodified `dist/jsQR.js` saved as `jsQR.cjs`.

Vendored for tests only: it is an independent QR *decoder* used to read back the QR codes the app encodes
(`tests/upi.test.ts`, `qa/desktop/upi-diagnose.mjs`). It is not part of the application bundle.
